title: Depth bounded by maximum list depth
statement: For any natural number $n$, any Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables, and any list $cs$ of such circuits containing $c$, the depth of $c$ is at most the maximum depth among the circuits in $cs$, with the maximum taken to be zero for the empty list.
hypotheses_covered: Circuit c belongs to the list cs
